APPROVE
The new `Read` drops to about 10 by moving the nested importers and packages branches and the two top-level ternaries into helpers, behaviour is identical (the `if`/`else if` chain replaces the old `continue`, `IsDependencySection(top)` matches the original pattern, and the `is { } packageKey` capture matches the old null check), and nothing in it should cause a warning, assuming no StyleCop SA1401 rule flags the public fields on the private `ReadState` class (I couldn't check the analyzer config or run the build).
